title: Vampire Vape Caribbean Ice E-Liquid 10ml
description: This sweet and juicy Caribbean Ice E-Liquid by Vampire Vape could be the perfect addition to your vape collection. Offering a world of tropical bliss, this tantalising blend captures the essence of a tropical cocktail with a refreshing twist of icy coolness. With each seriously smooth draw of this Caribbean ice 50/50 E-Liquid by Vampire Vape you can Indulge in the taste of paradise. As waves of refreshingly sweet mangos, sweeps across your taste buds. The tropical vibes continue with exotic notes of coconut. That adds a creamy richness to the blend, making this a delicious all-day vape. But what sets this Vampire Vape Caribbean Ice E-Liquid apart is the layer of invigorating menthol. Which brings a delightful icy kick to the mix. Ensuring that each puff can feel a refreshing breeze of the Caribbean washing over you, creating a truly immersive vaping experience. Crafted by Vampire Vape, this Caribbean Ice Vampire Vape 10ml E-Liquid has been designed to deliver maximum flavour and satisfying clouds by striking the ideal balance between PG and VG. Please Note: When choosing the right Vampire Vape Juice nicotine strength for your vaping needs, it's important to know the VG/PG ratio. The 3mg nicotine strength has a 50VG/50PG ratio, whilst the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg nicotine strengths have a 40VG/60PG composition. These versatile Vampire Vape juice blends are compatible with a wide range of vape devices. But they truly shine when paired with low-powered starter kits, pen-vape kits, and pod kits. If you're captivated by the delectable flavours of this Caribbean Ice by Vampire Vape, why not explore their other equally delicious E-Liquids. Such as their Vampire Vape Nic Salts or their Vampire Vape Bar Salts ranges? Their E-Liquid ranges cater to every vaper's unique flavour preferences. Ensuring there's always something new and exciting to discover. So whether you crave fruity delights, indulgent desserts, or refreshing menthol blends, you're sure to find the perfect vape juice to satisfy your taste buds and take your vaping to the next level.
